fusions.name: Seeding Jab
fusions.desc: A shallow jab that deals 3 poison damage and leaves spores in the wound, [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Burst
fusions.desc: Throws a point into the bloom that deals 16 poison damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Planted Sporestaff
fusions.desc: Plants a shaft that stands for 12 seconds and puffs spores at an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 poison damage every 1.5 seconds, each puff with a 40% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelium-Bound Haft
fusions.desc: Conjures a shaft threaded through with mycelium. It increases your weapon damage by 8% and your poison resistance by 10%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
